title: Single-Network Finite-Sample Inference in Strategic Network Formation Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.27505v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a finite-sample valid inference procedure for strategic network formation models with endogenous network statistics, using only a single observed network. We impose no restrictions on network density, equilibrium selection, or the dependence structure induced by strategic interaction. Using a "bounding-by-c" technique, we obtain realization-wise sandwich inequalities whose middle term depends only on exogenous covariates and i.i.d. pairwise shocks. These inequalities deliver pathwise identifying restrictions and simulable finite-sample critical values in both parametric and semiparametric settings. Our proposed procedure is also computationally tractable: it does not involve solving, simulating, or enumerating equilibrium (sub)networks, and easily scales to networks with 10000 agents in simulations. In two empirical applications, we find statistical evidence for positive link interdependence at the 95% confidence level.

translated_title: 战略网络形成模型中基于单一网络的有限样本推断
translated_abstract: 我们针对具有内生网络统计量的战略网络形成模型，开发了一种仅使用单一观测网络即可实现有限样本有效推断的方法。该方法对网络密度、均衡选择以及由策略互动所引致的依赖结构均不作任何限制。利用“以c为界的夹逼”技术，我们得到了逐实现意义上的三明治不等式，其中间项仅依赖于外生协变量和独立同分布的成对冲击。这些不等式在参数和半参数设定下均提供了逐路径识别约束和可模拟的有限样本临界值。我们所提出的方法在计算上也易于处理：无需求解、模拟或枚举均衡（子）网络，并且在模拟中可轻松扩展至包含10000个个体的网络。在两个实证应用中，我们在95%置信水平下发现了链接之间正相依性的统计证据。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅需单一观测网络、无需求解或模拟均衡、且对网络密度与依赖结构不作任何限制的有限样本有效推断方法，用于战略网络形成模型中内生网络统计量的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a finite-sample valid inference procedure for strategic network formation models using only a single observed network, without solving equilibria and without imposing restrictions on network density or the dependence structure induced by strategic interaction.
